string.name: c2_s1
string.value: 要偶坐下吗呀，吼呜？这样吗？简单啦...吼呜

string.name: c6_f4

string.name: c7_f4

string.value: 啊呀...主人，你真的吓到偶了呀...

string.name: c8_s4

string.name: c8_f1

string.name: c8_f2

string.name: c8_f4

string.value: 偶超级超级喜欢你呀！吼呜！
